title: Paradigm Helicopters

services.name: Custom Charters
services.desc: Paradigm Helicopters offer on-demand charter services, with our fleet of aircraft operating throughout Greater Houston, Texas. For the ultimate high-end experience, board our well-appointed Twin Engine Airbus H155 helicopter from atop The Post Oak Hotel at Uptown Houston and get a bird’s eye glimpse of the awe-inspiring scenery as you soar above Houston’s beautiful Uptown and Galleria areas. A personal travel concierge is ready to customize a flight to fit your needs.
